title: Nimble Mustard Uruguayan Snapper Ceviche
description: A bright, mustard-infused ceviche with snapper pearls that bounce in the glass, perfect for a FODMAP-friendly lunch.
instructions: Dice the snapper into 1cm cubes and place them in a mixing bowl.
Add the lime juice, orange juice, whole grain mustard, olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper to the fish and stir gently to coat.
Whisk the sodium alginate into a small bowl of fresh lime juice until fully dissolved, then pour this mixture over the fish and let it rest for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare a calcium chloride bath by dissolving the calcium chloride in 1 cup of cold water; then drop the fish-coated mixture into the bath to form small, bouncy pearls for 1 minute.
Drain the pearls and transfer them to a chilled serving glass; top with chopped cilantro, minced jalapeno, and cucumber slices; serve immediately.
